title: JACK STOWAGE
summary: Stowage of the jack and jack handle/wrench in the compartment behind the seat, under the storage tray and cover. The jack sits on the floor with the wrench beside it and is held down by a hold-down spring hooked over it and anchored at its lower end to a retainer that is fastened to the floor with item 6. A sticker goes on the underside of the cover; the carrier assembly sticker on the tray is from UPC 4.
